CORAM : AMIT BORKAR, J.
 DATED : FEBRUARY 8, 2023 P.C.:
1. Learned advocate for the appellant states that entire amount of compensation has been deposited by the appellant.

According to her, only point involved in these first appeals is that the rental compensation has been granted from the date of possession till the date of award instead of granting it till the date of notification under section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act.

2. Issue notice to the respondents, returnable on 21st March 2023.
3.
Considering the dispute about period of rental compensation, the claimants shall be entitled to withdraw the amount of compensation except the amount of rental compensation.
4. In that view of the matter, there shall be ad-interim relief in terms of prayer clause (b) in each matter.

(AMIT BORKAR, J.)
